caveats: 'Goon Squad' case: Michael Corey Jenkins and Eddie Terrell Parker sued Rankin County/RCSO after five RCSO deputies and one Richland Police Department officer raided their home Jan 24, 2023, torturing them (including sexual assault with objects and a mock execution in which Jenkins was shot in the mouth). Federal civil suit filed June 2023 (per WLBT); settled with prejudice for $2.5 million ($2M county insurance, $500K sheriff's budget), approved/dismissed April 30, 2025. All six officers pleaded guilty to federal and state charges; federal sentences totaled ~132 years (e.g., Dedmon 40 years, Elward 17.5 years). Not a single-officer case; one defendant was Richland PD, per slug. Sheriff denied liability in the settlement. Djournal (429), NPR (timeout), and NBC (403) sources failed to load.
